about_the_game:
In Chess of Doom, you are a fallen king, your kingdom reduced to ashes. To seize the Orb of Recreation and restore your realm, you must brave the dungeon depths, where bizarre foes and treacherous rooms await. This turn-based roguelike twists checkboard tactics into a relentless fight for survival.

Each run plunges you into procedurally generated floors, every chamber a test of wit. Move your king with chess-like precision, outwitting enemies wielding strange powers. Face mighty bosses in their lairs, barter in shop rooms, or risk challenge rooms teeming with enemy waves for rare treasures. Choose wisely - greed could be your doom.

As you descend, the dungeon grows trickier. Room effects twist your playstyle, forcing clever adaptations. Discover items to boost your strength or alter rooms, and collect soul cards to enhance your movements, crafting unique strategies each run. Will you play it safe or gamble for greater power?
